title: Bound shared phase-repair rank for independent groups
body:
## Result

This package closes a bounded relaxation left open by [PR #3220](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3220). For `G` independent direct-sum copies of its pinned rank-two port-zero defect, the joint defect has rank `2G`. Any repair by additional caller-level phase children must therefore carry total rank at least `2G`, even when repair children may span groups and routing is free. With each child rank at most 51 and `0 <= a <= 1/400`, that repair costs more than `G`, while the retained residual-repacking allowance is less than `153G/160`.

For the two-group integer relaxation, OR-Tools CP-SAT chooses one rank-four repair child and gives a lower-rounded cost of `3.986161`, versus a two-group allowance below `306/160 = 1.9125`. The standard-library replay independently reconstructs every exact integer-power objective floor and verifies the packing optimum by dynamic programming; OR-Tools is optional for the replay.

## Scope

The direct-sum premise is abstract. This does not bind two actual T740 groups, prove their source spaces disjoint, cover repairs absorbed into original children, changed interactions, or provide a complete routing/stock invoice. It establishes no new kappa, supplier admission, or selected-frontier change. The latest conditional kappa observed in the 2026-10-17 overlap refresh remains PR #3200's `0.001734807021726127552033`.

The final overlap query covered 274 open PRs and 2,011 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; it found no remote matches for the scoped terms. The canonical main refresh was unchanged at `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a` (priority revision 6). Related open question and attribution are recorded in [PR #3220](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3220) and the [mechanism-proposals hub](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167).

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-phase-repair-rank --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-phase-repair-rank
python3.10 research/shared-phase-repair-rank/ortools_shared_repair.py
```

The registered replay passed, including the pinned source bytes, exact Gaussian-integer rank, all-parameter cost bound and dynamic-programming verification of the CP-SAT optimum. `check_research_commit.py` passed for commit `8ec29a31efaaa99b4f7823c2d9db2142a4c810c3`.
